pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0136 preview residency and streaming
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR 0136 on current main with project-scoped preview residency, asynchronous renderer warm-up, frame-budgeted GPU uploads, stale startup reimport recovery, deterministic residency verification, ADR 0135 reclaim recovery, and full atomic import-generation promotion across source, contact, Humanoid-profile, and project skeleton-ledger inputs.
